data.message: Calibrating distributor here, anyone else have tasks in electrical?

data.name: Frank
data.message: Yeah, working on the distributor too.

data.name: Charlie
data.message: Heading to security to check cameras

data.name: Alice
data.message: Frank, you killed Alice! I saw Charlie leave to security last tick, only you were here with me!

data.name: Diana
data.message: Heading to weapons for asteroids task

I found Alice's body in electrical. My route was storage -> medbay -> electrical. I didn't see anyone else along the way — no one in storage, no one in medbay, and when I entered electrical Alice was already dead on the floor. So whoever killed her left before I arrived. I'd like to hear where everyone else was, especially anyone who came through medbay or cafeteria recently since those connect to electrical.

I was in electrical at the start of the round doing my task. Frank was in electrical with me from tick 2 through tick 4, and Alice came in from cafeteria at tick 3. So at tick 4, Frank, Alice, and I were all in electrical together. I left electrical and went to security after that — Diana came through security at tick 6, passing from navigation to weapons.

So Frank was the last person I can confirm was with Alice in electrical. Eve, you said Alice was already dead when you got there — Frank stayed behind with her after I left. Frank, where did you go and when did you leave electrical?

I was in upper engine and oxygen the entire round — went from upper engine to oxygen to do my O2 task, then came back to upper engine. I didn't see anyone the whole time, which makes sense since I was on the opposite side of the map from electrical.

So I can't directly confirm or deny anyone's story, but Charlie's account is pretty specific and testable. If Charlie's telling the truth, Frank was the last one with Alice in electrical. Frank, we really need to hear your route — when did you leave electrical, and did you see Eve come in? If Alice was already dead when Eve arrived, then either Frank killed her and left, or someone else slipped in between Frank leaving and Eve arriving.

Eve, did you pass anyone leaving electrical when you came in from medbay? That timing matters a lot.

Charlie's timeline is completely accurate. I was in electrical with Charlie and Alice. When Charlie left for security, I stayed just a second longer to finish my task, then headed north into cafeteria and eventually over to oxygen (where I am right now). Alice was absolutely alive when I walked out.

Eve, since you came from medbay and didn't see anyone, the killer must have slipped into electrical from either cafeteria right after I left, or from security. Charlie, you went to security — did you happen to check the cameras? Did you see anyone heading towards electrical after I left? Or is it possible you doubled back? I'm not directly accusing you, but the window of time between me leaving and Eve arriving is very tight. 

Since the timing is so narrow and we don't have a clear suspect who entered after me, I think we need more information before voting. I'll be skipping this round.

Okay, here's what I have. My route was navigation -> security -> weapons. I passed through security at tick 6 and saw Charlie there — that matches his story exactly. He came in from electrical, just like he said.

So Charlie's account checks out on my end. That puts Frank as the last confirmed person with Alice in electrical. Frank claims he went north to cafeteria then to oxygen — but Bob says he was in upper engine and oxygen the whole round and didn't see anyone. If Frank went to oxygen, Bob should have seen him there, or at least crossed paths. That's a contradiction.

Eve came from medbay and saw no one leaving electrical, which means the killer didn't exit toward medbay. Frank says he exited north to cafeteria — but no one has confirmed seeing him there either.

Between Charlie's confirmed alibi (verified by me) and Bob's claim of being in oxygen/upper engine, Frank's story has the biggest hole. I'm voting Frank.

Wait, I think there's some confusion with the speaking order — I already gave my initial report. But since I have the floor again, let me add to what's been said.

Diana's analysis is sharp. Frank claims he went cafeteria -> oxygen, but Bob says he was in oxygen and upper engine the entire round and saw no one. Those two stories can't both be true. One of them is lying.

To be fair to Frank — it's possible Bob just missed him in passing, or their timing didn't overlap perfectly. But combined with the fact that Frank was the last confirmed person with Alice, and I saw no one leaving electrical when I came in from medbay, Frank is the most suspicious by far.

I'm leaning Frank too, but I want to hear if Bob can tighten up his timing in oxygen before I lock it in.

Diana's analysis lines up with what I saw. Frank was definitely the last person in electrical with Alice — I left for security at tick 5, Frank stayed behind. And Diana confirmed my arrival in security at tick 6, so my alibi is solid.

The Frank vs Bob contradiction is the key. Frank says he went cafeteria -> oxygen. Bob says he was in oxygen and upper engine the whole round and saw no one. If Frank actually went to oxygen, Bob would have seen him — oxygen isn't that big. One of them is lying, and given that Frank was the last confirmed person alone with Alice, he's by far the more suspicious one.

To answer Frank's question: no, I didn't have time to check cameras — I had just arrived at security when the meeting was called. So I can't vouch for who entered electrical after I left, but I also didn't double back. Diana saw me in security at tick 6, and I stayed there.

I'm voting Frank.

To tighten up my timing: I left upper engine for oxygen pretty early, did my O2 task there, and came back to upper engine where I was when the meeting was called. I was in oxygen for several ticks in the middle of the round. I did not see Frank in oxygen at any point, and I didn't see anyone pass through upper engine either — and upper engine is the only way to get to oxygen from the cafeteria side via that corridor.

So if Frank actually went cafeteria -> oxygen, I should have seen him arrive in oxygen or pass me in upper engine. I saw neither. That's a direct contradiction with his claimed route.

Combined with Charlie's confirmed alibi (Diana saw him in security) and the fact that Frank was the last person alone with Alice in electrical, Frank's story doesn't hold up. I'm voting Frank.

Bob, you are either completely mistaken about your timing, or you're intentionally lying to frame me. I spent a long time in Cafeteria doing my task before I headed towards Oxygen. I literally just stepped into Oxygen right as the meeting was called! If you did your task and went back down to Upper Engine early, of course you wouldn't have seen me in Oxygen because I wasn't there yet. 

Charlie, I left Electrical right after you did and went straight north. I didn't stay with Alice. Eve walked into Electrical and found her dead — how do we know Eve didn't kill her and self-report, or that someone didn't come from Security or Storage while I was in Cafeteria? 

If you guys vote me out, you're going to realize you just threw a Goose out the airlock, and Bob is going to have a lot of explaining to do tomorrow. I'm voting Bob for pushing this false contradiction so hard.

Frank, your defense doesn't actually resolve the contradiction — it just shifts it. You're now claiming you spent "a long time" in cafeteria, but earlier you said you left electrical right after Charlie and "eventually" went to oxygen. If you were sitting in cafeteria that long, Eve passed near cafeteria coming from storage to medbay to electrical and would have had a window to see movement, and more importantly, no one saw you in cafeteria at all.

Meanwhile, Bob's story is internally consistent and doesn't conflict with anyone else's. Charlie's alibi is confirmed by me directly. The only person with an unverified route AND who was last confirmed alone with Alice is you, Frank.

Your attempt to flip on Bob at the last second feels like desperation. I'm sticking with my vote — Frank.
